# MatchChayn

MatchChayn is a modern dating and networking platform exclusively built for professionals.

## Overview
- **Domain:** matchchayn.com
- **Purpose:** Bridges the gap between career ambitions and personal connections.
- **Key Features:** Intentional matching, professional networking, curated events, dual-purpose profiles.
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, Resend (Email), Upstash (QStash).
- **Developer:** Heritage Isaac

## Project Structure
- **/src/app:** Next.js App Router pages and API routes.
- **/src/components:** Reusable React components and UI elements.
- **/src/emails:** React Email templates (Waitlist, Newsletter).
- **/src/services:** Business logic (Queue, Webhooks).

## Usage
Users can join the waitlist or subscribe to the newsletter via the main landing page. Data is processed securely, and automated welcome emails are dispatched immediately via background queues.
